verdict.rationale: An identity-verification SaaS could plausibly offer AI-generated insights or suggestions, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such in-product feature. Automated fraud detection, manual review tools, and the Stripe MCP server for external agents are adjacent capabilities, not AI-generated insights or suggestions delivered to the user inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
